paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni in, Esther in akumpi puansilh asilh a, kumpipa' inn zawn a, kumpipa pisa sungnungzaw pen ah ava dingh a; kumpipa bel inn lutna zawn a, kumpi inn ah alaltutphah tung ah atu hi.
heading: Esther In An Ne Ding In Kumpipa Leh Haman Achial
english: Now on the third day, Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, next to the king’s house. The king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, next to the entrance of the house.

paite: Hichibang ahi a, kumpipa'n pisa a kumpinu Esther dingh amuh in, amitmuh in deihsakna atangta: kumpipa'n akhut a om dangka-eng kumpi chiang Esther lam ah alik hi. Huchi in Esther ahong painai a, kumpi chiangdawn ahong khoih hi.
english: When the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, she obtained favor in his sight; and the king held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. So Esther came near and touched the top of the scepter.

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bang na deih a, kumpinu Esther? Na ngetna bang ahia? Gam kimkhat tan leng piak na hi ding," achi hi.
english: Then the king asked her, “What would you like, queen Esther? What is your request? It shall be given you even to the half of the kingdom.”

paite: Huchi in Esther in, "Kumpipa'n hoih asakleh tuni in kumpipa leh Haman amah a dia ka bawl an nekna ah hong pai un," achi hi.
english: Esther said, “If it seems good to the king, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him.”

paite: Huan kumpipa'n, "Esther gen bang a hih ahihtheihna ding in Haman kinohsak un," achi hi. Huchi in Esther an nekna abawl ah kumpipa leh Haman ahong uhi.
english: Then the king said, “Bring Haman quickly, so that it may be done as Esther has said.” So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

paite: Huan uain adawn lai un kumpipa'n Esther kiang ah, "Bang ahia na thumna? Phal ahihtheihna ding in bang ahia na ngetna? Gam kimkhat tan in leng piak ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: The king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

paite: Esther in adawng a, "Ka thumna leh ka ngetna hiai ahi:
english: Then Esther answered and said, “My petition and my request is this.

paite: Kumpipa mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, ka thumna phal ding leh ka ngetna bawl ding a kumpipa alungkimleh, kumpipa leh Haman, amau a dia ka bawl ding an nekna ah hong le uh, kumpipa'n achih bang in zingchiang in ka hih ding," achi hi.
english: If I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I will prepare for them, and I will do tomorrow as the king has said.”

paite: Huchi in huai ni in nuamsa leh lung kipak in Haman apaikheta a: himahleh Mordekai kumpipa kongpi a om, Haman in ama a Mordekai dingh lou a tat leng tang lou amuh in, atung ah aheh mahmah hi.
heading: Haman In Mordekai Thah Atum
english: Then Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart, but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he didn’t stand up nor move for him, he was filled with wrath against Mordecai.

paite: Huchi in leng Haman aki-ip teitei a, inn ah apaita; huan mi asawl a alawmte leh azi Zeresh ahon tonpih hi.
english: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself, and went home. There, he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.

paite: Haman in akiang uah, ahauhsakna thupina leh atate tamdan leh kumpipa'n akaisansakna thil tengteng leh kumpipa sikhate vaihawmte tung a amasak tuamdan agen hi.
english: Haman recounted to them the glory of his riches, the multitude of his children, all the things in which the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

paite: Haman in, ahi, "Esther in an nekna abawl ah kumpipa toh kei chih louh ngal mi kuamah ahohsak kei; zingchiang in leng kumpipa toh kei ahon sam hi.
english: Haman also said, “Yes, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and tomorrow I am also invited by her together with the king.

paite: Himahleh Mordekai huai Juda mipa, kumpipa kongpi a tu ka muh lai teng hiaite tengteng kei a ding in bangmah aphatuam kei,” achi lai hi.
english: Yet all this avails me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.”

paite: Huchi in azi Zeresh leh alawmte'n akiang ah, "Khailupna khuam tong sawmnga a sang kibawl henla, zingsang in nang kumpipa kiang ah thu gen inla, huai a Mordekai khailup ahihtheihna ding in; huchi in vualnuamtak in kumpipa toh an nekna ah na hoh ding uh," achi uhi. Hiai in Haman akipaksak a; huchi in khailupna khuam abawlsakta hi.
english: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, “Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high, and in the morning speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on it. Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet.” This pleased Haman, so he had the gallows made.
